items.name: base
items.title: DataServices base
items.description: Starts a new app on the design system: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest init -t vite -n my-app <registry>/base.json. Sets up components.json with the @dataservices registry and installs theme-base, the Ocotillo theme, the DS cn() (lib/utils.ts), the theme provider and the DS button, whose CSS the CLI merges into src/index.css.

items.name: theme
items.title: OcotilloUI Theme (legacy)
items.description: Legacy: merges the OcotilloUI palette into the app's CSS as shadcn cssVars. New apps should install theme-base plus one theme file (theme-ocotillo, theme-nmwdi); see THEMING.md. OcotilloUI (NMBGMRDataManager) production palette and typography — the Ocotillo brand blue, amber, red, orange, emerald and teal over neutral greys. Outfit headings, Public Sans body.

items.name: theme-base
items.title: Theme base
items.description: Shared design-system CSS: imports, dark variant, fonts, type steps, @theme inline token mappings, radius scale and minimal base styles (body colors, heading font). Sets no colors; add a theme too.
items.docs: The CLI merged the design system's base CSS into your CSS entry. It sets no colors, so the app also needs a theme such as @dataservices/theme-ocotillo. It defines the dark variant as (&:is(.dark *)), like shadcn's templates; if your CSS already had a different @custom-variant dark, delete one of the two. See THEMING.md in the DataServices design system.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn() with DS type steps
items.description: The stock shadcn cn() (clsx + tailwind-merge), configured so the design system's type steps (text-display, text-eyebrow) merge as font sizes instead of being mistaken for colors. Replaces lib/utils.ts.

items.name: theme-ocotillo
items.title: Ocotillo theme
items.description: OcotilloUI palette (brand blue and amber over neutral greys), light and dark. The default theme: it fills the :root and .dark blocks, so it applies whenever no other theme is selected with data-theme.
items.docs: The CLI merged the Ocotillo palette into your :root and .dark blocks. No data-theme is needed.

items.name: theme-nmwdi
items.title: NMWDI theme
items.description: New Mexico Water Data Initiative palette (teal, terracotta, sand), light and dark, scoped to <html data-theme="nmwdi">. Used by Weaver.
items.docs: The CLI merged the NMWDI palette into your CSS under :root[data-theme="nmwdi"]. Set data-theme="nmwdi" on <html>, or pass palette="nmwdi" to ThemeProvider.

items.name: theme-provider
items.title: Theme Provider
items.description: Light/dark/system theme context with localStorage persistence (storageKey 'dsds-theme'). Exposes useTheme(), including resolvedTheme ("system" resolved from the OS).

items.name: mode-toggle
items.title: Mode Toggle
items.description: Light/dark toggle button. Reads resolvedTheme from the theme provider, so it follows the system preference when theme is 'system'.

items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: MapLibre map primitive with a token-free CARTO basemap, New Mexico default extent, and nav/scale controls. Re-exports react-map-gl/maplibre primitives.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Generic client-side table over @tanstack/react-table — sortable headers (DataTableColumnHeader), column filter, column visibility, and pagination built in.

items.name: data-grid
items.title: Data Grid (editable)
items.description: Canvas-based editable spreadsheet grid (Glide Data Grid) with a row-object API and light/dark theming built from the current theme's tokens. Pass columns keyed to row fields plus rows; provide onRowsChange for editing.
items.docs: Glide Data Grid 6.0.3 declares React 16–18 as peers. It runs on React 19, but npm refuses the install. If it did, add "overrides": { "@glideapps/glide-data-grid": { "react": "$react", "react-dom": "$react-dom" } } to package.json and run the add again. pnpm and yarn only warn.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Upstream shadcn switch (Radix Switch).

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state pressable toggle button (Radix Toggle) with default/outline variants and sm/default/lg sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Segmented set of toggles (Radix ToggleGroup) sharing variant/size; single or multiple selection.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Single-select radio options (Radix RadioGroup) themed to OcotilloUI.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: react-hook-form + zod form primitives: Form, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, useFormField. Accessible labels, descriptions, and validation messages wired automatically.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette / list primitives over cmdk: Command, CommandDialog, CommandInput, CommandList, CommandEmpty, CommandGroup, CommandItem, CommandShortcut, CommandSeparator.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Upstream shadcn combobox (Base UI Combobox): a searchable input with a filtered list, for single or multiple selection with chips.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Side drawer (Radix Dialog) sliding from any edge — for filter panels and detail views.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Upstream shadcn alert-dialog (Radix AlertDialog): a confirm dialog for destructive actions.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable split panes (react-resizable-panels) — pair with Map for split map/table layouts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Upstream shadcn button. Adds size="xl" (48px call to action) and variant="inverse" (light button for dark bands and images).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Upstream shadcn badge. Adds status variants (success, warning, info), category tones (tone-1 … tone-6) and an on-image outline variant.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Upstream shadcn alert. Adds success, warning and info variants on the status tokens.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Upstream shadcn tabs (Radix Tabs).

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Upstream shadcn card.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Upstream shadcn accordion (Radix Accordion). An open item doesn't clip overflowing content, so a dropdown inside it can escape the item's box.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Upstream shadcn input-group: an input or textarea with addons, buttons and text.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key and key group (upstream shadcn kbd), e.g. a ⌘K hint inside an input group.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts wrapper: ChartContainer (injects the --chart-1..5 theme tokens as --color-* vars), plus themed ChartTooltip/ChartTooltipContent and ChartLegend/ChartLegendContent. Pass a ChartConfig and recharts chart children.

items.name: echart
items.title: EChart
items.description: Apache ECharts React wrapper for heavy/interactive charting (large series, dataZoom, brush, geo, heatmap). Auto resize/dispose, a theme built from the --chart-1..5 and surface tokens, re-themed when the mode or data-theme changes. Pass a raw ECharts option.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumb navigation trail with separators and an ellipsis for collapsed paths. Links accept the app router via asChild.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: Hook returning whether the viewport is below the mobile breakpoint (768px), via useSyncExternalStore.

items.name: use-css-vars
items.title: useCssVars
items.description: Hook that reads design-token values (CSS custom properties) off <html> and re-reads them when the light/dark class or data-theme changes. For canvas renderers that can't use CSS variables.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible app sidebar (offcanvas/icon), with provider, keyboard shortcut, cookie-persisted state, mobile Sheet fallback, and a full set of menu/group primitives. Themed via the OcotilloUI --sidebar tokens.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date calendar built on react-day-picker v10, themed to OcotilloUI. Supports single, multiple, and range selection.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: DatePicker (single) and DateRangePicker (start/end) built on Popover + Calendar, with date-fns formatting.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Upstream shadcn avatar: an image with a fallback, plus badges and groups.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Upstream shadcn checkbox (Radix Checkbox).

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Upstream shadcn collapsible (Radix Collapsible): show and hide a section.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Upstream shadcn dialog (Radix Dialog): a modal window over the page.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Upstream shadcn dropdown menu (Radix DropdownMenu).

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Upstream shadcn field: label, description and error layout for form controls, vertical or horizontal (Field, FieldGroup, FieldSet, FieldLabel, FieldTitle, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldSeparator).

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Upstream shadcn input: a single-line text field.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Upstream shadcn label (Radix Label) for form controls.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Upstream shadcn navigation-menu (Radix NavigationMenu): site links with optional dropdown panels.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Upstream shadcn popover (Radix Popover): rich content in a floating panel.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Upstream shadcn progress bar (Radix Progress).

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Upstream shadcn select (Radix Select): pick one option from a list.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Upstream shadcn separator (Radix Separator): a horizontal or vertical rule.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Upstream shadcn skeleton: a placeholder shape while content loads.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Upstream shadcn spinner: an animated loading indicator with role="status".

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Upstream shadcn slider (Radix Slider): pick a value or range.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Toasts (Sonner). Upstream shadcn sonner, reading the mode from the DS ThemeProvider instead of next-themes.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Shadcn table with a containerClassName prop for the scrolling wrapper: a plain, static table.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Upstream shadcn textarea: a multi-line text field.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Upstream shadcn tooltip (Radix Tooltip): a short label on hover or focus.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Frame for tool-style apps: a sidebar that collapses to an icon rail (with nested sections, actions and a footer), a top bar, a content area that scrolls on its own, and a resizable side panel. Router-agnostic; becomes a menu sheet below the md breakpoint.

items.name: top-nav
items.title: Top Nav
items.description: Navigation bar for content sites (use app-shell for tool-style apps): brand on the left, NavigationMenu links on the right, in a wide (max-w-7xl) row. Below the md breakpoint the links move into a Sheet. Takes links, pathname and renderLink like app-shell; the most specific link containing pathname is marked current.

items.name: basemap-selector
items.title: Basemap Selector
items.description: Grid of selectable basemap thumbnails, built on RadioGroup so arrow keys move the selection. Presentational and map-library agnostic — the consumer owns the style list and applies the chosen id to its map. Pairs with the Map primitive.

items.name: layer-selector
items.title: Layer Selector
items.description: Checkable list of map layers, each with a legend swatch, opacity slider, and a settings popover for attribute filters, categorical facet chips, no-data and clustering toggles, and color overrides. Presentational — the consumer owns the catalog and visibility state. Exports LayerSelector and PointSwatch.

items.name: field-value
items.title: Field Value
items.description: Renders a feature/record attribute value: URLs become a clickable host link, 'CODE: Label' coded values render the code as an outline Badge beside its label, USGS-style approval states (Approved/Provisional) render as a success/warning Badge, and everything else is plain text.

items.name: filter-controls
items.title: Filter Controls
items.description: Filter-to-map-extent switch plus a debounced text attribute filter (commits ~250ms after typing stops), with an info tooltip. Controlled via bbox/q props and onBboxChange/onQueryChange callbacks.
